items.title: Covenant Health says May data breach impacted nearly 478,000 patients
items.description: The Covenant Health organization has revised to nearly 500,000 the number of individuals affected by a data breach discovered last May. [...]

items.title: Cryptocurrency theft attacks traced to 2022 LastPass breach
items.description: Blockchain investigation firm TRM Labs says ongoing cryptocurrency thefts have been traced to the 2022 LastPass breach, with attackers draining wallets years after encrypted vaults were stolen and laundering the crypto through Russian exchanges. [...]
